dialog.english:
We're all separated. I bet they're
doin' all fine, but...
dialog.translation:
Estamos todos separados. Espero
que todos estén bien...

dialog.english:
I hate this. Where are we? Where
did everyone go?
dialog.translation:
Odio esto. Dónde estamos? Dónde
están los demás?

dialog.english:
I'm sure everyone's looking for
you, Mimi. So push through this
and keep going. I sure am!
dialog.translation:
Estoy seguro que todos te están
buscando, Mimi. Sé fuerte y sigue
adelante. Estoy seguro!

dialog.english:
They're Scumon and Chuumon.
They're always together.
dialog.translation:
Son Scumon y Chuumon. Están
siempre juntos.

dialog.english:
Nice to meet you! Or how about we
give you a proper greeting, with
poop?
dialog.translation:
Un placer! Qué tal si me presento
propiamente... con caca?

dialog.english:
If you don't like it, give us all
your stuff!
dialog.translation:
Si no te gusta, dános todo lo que
tienes!

dialog.english: Are you trying to rob us?!
Yep! Give us all you've got!

No way! I'd rather throw all my
stuff into a pit than give it to
you!
dialog.translation:
Ni de broma! Antes tiro las cosas
a un foso que dártelas a ti!

dialog.english:
Then how about we cover you in
poop?
dialog.translation: Y qué tal si te cubrimos de caca?

dialog.english:
*You'll* be the ones covered in
poop!

Aaah, for some reason I feel
refreshed.
dialog.translation:
Ahh, de algún modo me siento
renovado.
Bueno, YO no me siento así!

dialog.english:
I feel like I've become a good
poop.
dialog.translation:
Siento que me convertí en caca
buena.

dialog.english: A good poop, a good poop!

Now that that's settled, I have a
question for you. Have you seen
any humans around here?
dialog.translation:
Ahora que está solucionado, tengo
una pregunta. Habéis visto algún
humano por aquí?

dialog.english:
Come to think of it... I saw a
Tentomon and a creature like you
go into the Antigua Región Dino.
dialog.translation:
Ahora que lo dices... Vi un
Tentomon y una criatura yendo a
la Antigua Región Dino.

dialog.english:
If he's with a Tentomon, he must
be Izzy!

The Antigua Región Dino's straight
ahead. Well, then, bye-bye!
dialog.translation:
La Antigua Región Dino está yendo
recto. Bueno, hasta luego!

dialog.english:
This must be the Ancient Dino
Region!
dialog.translation:
Debe ser la Antigua Región
Dino!

dialog.english:
Mimi, why don't you try talking to
Izzy for now?
dialog.translation:
Mimi, por qué no intentas hablar
con Izzy?

dialog.english:
Mimi, why don't you try talking to
Izzy for now?
dialog.translation:
Mimi, por qué no intentas hablar
con Izzy?

dialog.english:
I'm so glad you're here! Where's
everyone else?
dialog.translation:
Que bien que estás aquí! Donde
está el resto?

dialog.english:
I don't know. But more
importantly...
dialog.translation: No lo sé, pero antes de eso...

dialog.english:
If I analyze these characters, I
may be able to figure out what's
happening to this island.
dialog.translation:
Si analizo estos caracteres,
quizás descubra qué le está
pasando a esta isla.

dialog.english:
Since I'm busy now, we should
search for them later.
dialog.translation:
Ya que estoy ocupado, deberíamos
buscarles luego.

dialog.english:
First time I evolved we found
characters kinda like these.
dialog.translation:
En mi primera Digievolución había
caracteres como estos.

dialog.english:
So... how long will I have to
wait?

If you figure it out, will it get
us home?
dialog.translation:
Si lo descifras, nos iremos a
casa?

dialog.english:
Don't cry, Mimi, or I'm gonna
start crying too...
dialog.translation:
No llores, Mimi, o lloraré
yo también...

dialog.english:
Y-your crying is only going to
inconvenience us further.
dialog.translation:
Q-Que llores sólo nos retrasará
aún más.

dialog.english:
I'm starving! I'm thirsty! I miss
everyone! I hate being here!
dialog.translation:
Tengo hambre! Y sed! Echo a todos
de menos! Odio todo esto!

dialog.english:
If I analyze this data, it'll help
you in the end as well, Mimi.
dialog.translation:
Si analizo estos datos, te
ayudará a ti también, Mimi.

dialog.english:
I'm not gonna deal with you
anymore, Izzy!
dialog.translation: No voy a soportarte más, Izzy!

dialog.english:
I can't keep this up! Too much
weight!
Ow ow ow...seems we fell p'far.
dialog.translation: Au au au... si que era hondo.

dialog.english:
I'm tired of these ruins! I wanna
go home!
dialog.translation:
Estoy harta de estas ruinas! Me
quiero ir!

dialog.english:
Mimiiiiiiii! We gotta get back to
Izzy!
dialog.translation:
Mimiiii! Tenemos que volver con
Izzy!

dialog.english:
Noooo! I don't want to hear him
blubbering on and on like he does!
dialog.translation:
Noo! No quiero escucharle
balbucear constantemente como
hace!

dialog.english: Don't go runnin' off by yourself!

Prolly be useful to remember for
later.
Try not to fall this time.

Good, you can hear me! I'll
navigate for you, so please walk
in the direction I indicate.
dialog.translation:
Bien, me oyes! Te guiaré, así que
por favor, anda en la dirección
que te diga.

dialog.english:
We're saved, Mimi! Izzy's
gonna do what he can to help us.
dialog.translation:
Estamos salvados Mimi! Izzy
nos va a ayudar.

dialog.english:
Apparently, there's a mysterious
power in these ruins.
dialog.translation:
Aparentemente las ruinas tienen
un poder misterioso.

dialog.english:
The characters on the wall follow
the same principle as the ones in
Andromon's factory.
dialog.translation:
Los caracteres en la pared siguen
el mismo principio que los de la
fábrica de Andromon.

dialog.english:
Hmph, that's great and all, but
does that mean anything?
dialog.translation:
Hm, suena bien, pero significa
algo?

dialog.english:
There's probably a lot of hole
traps around you, Mimi, but..
dialog.translation:
Seguramente haya muchos hoyos
alrededor de ti, Mimi, pero...

dialog.english:
...according to the data, there's
a message that reads...

"A road with a pattern is good, a
road without is bad."
dialog.translation:
"El buen camino sigue un patrón,
sin él, será el malo."

dialog.english:
Pattern? What's that supposed to
mean?
dialog.translation:
Patrón? Que se supone que
significa?

dialog.english:
Do you see any patterns out of the
ordinary anywhere?
dialog.translation:
Ves algún patrón fuera de lo
común en algún lugar?

dialog.english: I don't wanna do this anymore...

I've found the locations of all
the hole traps!
dialog.translation:
Encontré el lugar de todos los
agujeros!

dialog.english:
You can get through if you follow
my instructions.
dialog.translation:
Puedes pasar si sigues mis
instrucciones.

dialog.english:
Studying this place is important.
You should proceed after you
prepare yourself.
dialog.translation:
Estudiar este lugar es
importante. Deberías continuar
tras prepararte.

dialog.english:
I mean, that place's atmosphere
might have an effect on your
behavior, and...
dialog.translation:
Quiero decir, la atmósfera del
lugar podría afectar tus
acciones, y...

dialog.english:
Amazing, Mimi! You did it without
needing my advice.
dialog.translation:
Genial, Mimi! Y lo hiciste sin mi
ayuda.

dialog.english:
The way you said that worries me a
bit, but whatever! If there's a
will, there's always a way!
dialog.translation:
Dicho así me preocupa un poco,
pero da igual! Quien quiere,
puede!

dialog.english:
It really was amazing. But the
ability to take action is what's
most important, right?
dialog.translation:
Ha sido increíble. Pero la
habilidad de tomar la iniciativa
es lo importante, verdad?

dialog.english:
Ugh, I've had enough of falling
down holes!
dialog.translation:
Uh, ya basta de caerse por
agujeros!

dialog.english:
Maybe we should be stoppin' here
for a bit.
dialog.translation:
Quizás deberíamos parar aquí un
poco.

dialog.english:
There's another one of those
strange patterns down here...
dialog.translation:
Aquí hay otro de esos extraños
patrones...

dialog.english: Mimi! Mimiiiiii! Can you hear me?

Mimi! Are you okay?! I'm worried
about you!

We're pulling through, somehow!
Tentomon's here, too!
dialog.translation:
Vamos tirando, de algún modo!
Tentomon está aquí!

dialog.english:
We're counting on you, Tentomon!
Anyway, about these ruins...
dialog.translation:
Contamos contigo, Tentomon!
Bueno, sobre las ruinas...

dialog.english:
This room seems to be called the
"Room of the Sun and Moon".
dialog.translation:
Esta sala parece llamarse
"Sala del Sol y la Luna"

dialog.english:
And there seem to be some rules
about this room.
dialog.translation:
Y parece haber normas sobre
esta sala.

dialog.english:
"After ○ is ×, after × is □,
after □ is ○ again,"

It means "unable to return back to
where you were before".

I'm sorry. I'll keep analyzing it
some more!

Hm...looks like we've got no
choice but to try for now.

The floor started shining all of a
sudden!

The floor? It must be some
mechanism in the ruins.

Mechanism? Like a trap? Are we
gonna be okay?

Um...It's apparently a mechanism
to trap intruders.

It doesn't look like the kind of
trap that inflicts damage, but...

That's a relief, but I'm still
nervous.

Anyway, back to that hint from
before! Uh...?

This room's called the "Room of
the Sun and Moon".

"After ○ is ×, after × is □,
after □ is ○ again,"

What does it mean?! Did we mess
up? Did we do something wrong?!

Mimi, it looks like we couldn't
get past the mechanism.

Like I said, it doesn't seem to
have inflicted any damage, but...

It looks like there's no other
option but to try it again.

So I have another chance. That's
comforting.
Looks like we messed up again...

Ugh, at this rate we're gonna
spend the rest of our lives here.
Eh?! The rest of our lives?!

I'm joking! But still, we've gotta
figure something out...

You did it, Mimi! You solved the
trap puzzle!

The mechanism released and the
door opened!

You should prepare yourself
emotionally again. It's dangerous
to act blindly.

You're too influenced by your
emotions, Mimi; they might lead
you into a pit.
Ghhhh! What's with you? So rude!

I-I'm only trying to view this
objectively...

Amazing, Mimi! You did it on your
own!

Haha, look, I'm the best, aren't
I?

Just kidding! I did it with
Izzy's help, after all!
Well then, let's keep at it!

Mimi! We're gon' end up in that
trap again if we keep goin' that
way!

Mimi! We're gon' fall into a pit
if we keep goin' that way!

Watch out! There's a signal
showing a Digimon approaching from
behind!

What're you saying? Come on, we
gotta get back to Izzy and
Palmon!
Did I just have a weird dream?
This is bad! We're at a dead end!
My life's flashin' before my eyes!
No way! We're giving up now?

There's no way out, and I can't
evolve...

It's not my fault! I can't evolve
if Izzy ain't here!

It's dangerous in there! We have
to escape from Centarumon!
Looks like he's back to normal.
Looks like he's back to normal.

Those things! Those things you're
holding!

There's something I want to show
you. Come this way.

This is the holy device, the
"Digivice". I have long protected
its ruins.

That is the holy Digivice of
legend. It brings light to this
world and drives out the darkness.

I don't really understand, but
you're saying it's good to have
these, right?

Those who interfere with our
objective...
Leomon! It's happened to you, too!

It "brings light and drives out
the darkness"...The Digivice.
That's it! Mimi!

Is this the power of the holy
device?

We survived, but I'm still pretty
hungry.

Centarumon, do you know how to
stop the gears in these ruins?

No, there is nothing I can do
against this dark power.

Looks like I really do have no
choice but to analyze this data.

Ugh, we're gonna end up waiting a
million years! Hyah!

The island is moving! It's going
back!

I guess sometimes you won't know
if you don't try.
My heart was in a rush...

I can't see nothin', but I hear
somethin'. Could it be a ghost?

No, no, no, stop that! Who are
you? Say something!

Thank goodness, are you safe?
Tentomon too, are you okay?

What are you talking about? The
problem is this pile!

I've decrypted the equipment
in these ruins. You can think
of them like speakers.
Mimi, I'm here too! Are you okay?

You too, Palmon! We're fine! Rest
easy!

It seems like you two
have fallen into a pit.

If you want to find the right way,
you need the crest of another
room.

Ah, we're finally safe. We cleared
that pit area.
Y-you cleared that on your own?

Still, be careful as you keep
going.

I'll continue investigating, I
want to help you as much as I can.
